translations.path.cs.title: Kɔmputɛri Hakilila & Porogaramasiyɔn
translations.path.cs.description: Kalan kɛ kɔmputɛri kɔnɔ fɛnw gundola, aligoritimu la, ani Python kalan na.
translations.path.cyber.title: Danbɛ Kisili & Enpormatiki Lakanani
translations.path.cyber.description: I yɛrɛ tanga kalansira jugumanw ma, telefon konti lakanani, ani internet lakanani.
translations.level.beginner.title: Daminɛbagaw (Beginner)
translations.level.beginner.description: Sintegɛ fɔlɔw kɔmputɛri ani lakanani gundow la.
translations.level.intermediate.title: Cɛmancɛ (Intermediate)
translations.level.intermediate.description: Gɛlɛyabɔli jurukuruw ani porogaramu barikama labɛnni.
translations.mod.cs01.title: 1. Aligoritimu Daminɛ & KalanCode (klncd)
translations.mod.cs01.description: Faamuya sɔrɔ aligoritimu la ani KalanCode pseudocode ka kɛnɛma fɔlɔ S3b3n() ani Doon().
translations.mod.cs02.title: 2. Doninfenw & Suguya (Variables & Types - Python)
translations.mod.cs02.description: Hakilidaga kɔnɔ fɛn bila, int, float, str, bool ani Python laseko.
translations.mod.cs03.title: 3. Kɛbaga Jurukuruw (Operators & Expressions)
translations.mod.cs03.description: Jateminɛ kɛcogo, faranfasi kɛli, ani hakilina cogo la.
translations.mod.cs04.title: 4. Saritiw & Desiziyɔnw (Conditions & Decisions)
translations.mod.cs04.description: Ni... o kɔ... (if, elif, else) kɔmputɛri bɛ desiziyɔn ta cogo min na.
translations.mod.cs05.title: 5. Murutibaaw & Seginkaninw (Loops & Iterations)
translations.mod.cs05.description: Baara segin-segin for ani while jurukuruw kɔnɔ.
translations.mod.cs06.title: 6. Baarakɛlaw (Functions & Modular Programming)
translations.mod.cs06.description: Kalan kulu labɛnni def ye, parameeterew ani segin-don.
translations.mod.cs07.title: 7. Kunnafonidaga (Data Structures)
translations.mod.cs07.description: Lisitiw (list) ani Dictionnairew (dict) kɔnɔ fɛn teliya marali.
translations.mod.cs08.title: 8. Gɛlɛyabɔli Jurukuruw (Advanced Algorithms)
translations.mod.cs08.description: Ɲiningali teliya ɲinini ani aligoritimu barikamaw.
translations.mod.cs09.title: 9. Porogaramu Lakanani (Defensive Programming)
translations.mod.cs09.description: Filiw minɛni try/except fɛ ani debɔgɛri teliya la.
translations.mod.cyber01.title: 1. Telefon & Numɛriki Saniyali
translations.mod.cyber01.description: SIM Swap, Orange Money konti, ani kodipini lakanani.
translations.mod.cyber02.title: 2. Kalansira Juguman (Phishing SMS & Web)
translations.mod.cyber02.description: SMS jugumanw kɔlɔsili ani gundofuruw tangali.
translations.mod.cyber03.title: 3. Tɔgɔsɛbɛn & Dabaarakɛ (Authentication & 2FA)
translations.mod.cyber03.description: Mots de passe barikama ani 2FA gundolakanani.
translations.mod.cyber04.title: 4. Internet Kɛnɛma & Telefon Yirali
translations.mod.cyber04.description: HTTPS dɔnni ani telefon aplikasiyɔn ka yamaruya kolosili.
translations.les.cs0101.title: Aligoritimu ye mun ye ? (Taji kɛcogo)
translations.les.cs0101.summary: Dɔn cogo min na aligoritimu ye cogo ye ka gɛlɛya dɔ bɔ sen fɛ sen fɛ.
translations.les.cs0101.act1.title: Sikansi : Sen fɛ sen fɛ
translations.les.cs0101.act1.content: Aligoritimu ye laadilikan ye min bɛ kɔmputɛri bila ka baara kɛ sen fɛ sen fɛ. Misali : Taji bori cogo.
translations.les.cs0101.act1.takeaway: N'i ma senw labɛn cogo ɲuman na, baara tɛ se ka dafa.
translations.les.cs0101.ex1.instruction: Taji bori senw bila ɲɔgɔn kɔ cogo ɲuman na.
translations.les.cs0101.ex1.hint: Tasuma bɛ daminɛ fɔlɔ, o kɔ ji bɛ bila...
translations.les.cs0101.ex1.success: I ni ce ! I ye taji aligoritimu labɛn cogo ɲuman na.
translations.les.cs0101.ex1.failure: Sikansi ma dafa. Segin k'a lajɛ ka kɔrɔsi.
translations.les.cs0102.title: KalanCode kɔnɔ sɛbɛnni kɛ ni S3b3n() ye
translations.les.cs0102.summary: Dɔn cogo min na kɔmputɛri bɛ kuma fɔ ka a jira ekran kan.
translations.les.cs0102.act1.title: KalanCode ka kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya : S3b3n
translations.les.cs0102.act1.content: Walasa kɔmputɛri ka kunnafoni jira i la, an bɛ baara kɛ ni 'klncd.S3b3n()' ye.
translations.les.cs0102.act1.takeaway: S3b3n bɛ fɛn o fɛn bila kɛsu kɔnɔ k'a jira écran kan.
translations.les.cs0102.ex1.instruction: KalanCode code in sɛbɛn ka 'I ni ce !' jira.
translations.les.cs0102.ex1.success: I ni ce ! I ye i ka sɛbɛnni fɔlɔ lase a dan ma.
translations.les.cs0102.ex1.failure: Fili dɔ bɛ sɛbɛnni la. Lajɛ kɔsebe.
translations.les.cs0103.title: Kumaɲɔgɔnya kɛ ni Doon() ye
translations.les.cs0103.summary: Kɔmputɛri bɛ ɲiningali kɛ mɔgɔ ma ka jaabi mara variable kɔnɔ.
translations.les.cs0103.act1.title: KalanCode ka doninfen : Doon
translations.les.cs0103.act1.content: klncd.Doon() bɛ ɲiningali kɛ mɔgɔ ma console kan, ka kɔnɔni kɛ fo i ka jaabi.
translations.les.cs0103.act1.takeaway: Doon() bɛ jaabi ta ka bila variable kɔnɔ.
translations.les.cs0103.ex1.instruction: Doon() kɛ ka mɔgɔ tɔgɔ ɲininka, sɔrɔ ka a bisimila.
translations.les.cs0103.ex1.success: I ni ce kosɛbɛ ! I ye kumaɲɔgɔnya aligoritimu dafa.
translations.les.cs0103.ex1.failure: Doon() ma dafa. Kɔlɔsi k'a lajɛ kokura.
translations.ui.module.locked.hint: 🔒 Kalan fɔlɔ dafa walasa kulu nata ka yɛlɛ.
translations.ui.modal.celebrate.title: I ni ce ! I ye kulu kura laka !
translations.ui.modal.celebrate.body: I ye kalan in dafa. Kulu nata laloira i bolo kaban.
translations.ui.exercise.label: Baara consigne
translations.ui.exercise.click.order: Cɛcɛta fɛ senkun cogo ɲuman na kan :
